preconditions.description: The number of lamps n is between 2 and 2 * 10^5, inclusive.
Each index a_i of the main lamp for a wire is between 1 and n, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: k is an integer and 1 <= k <= n
postconditions.description: The index k of the lamp connected to the power grid must be between 1 and n, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: Each pair (x_i, y_i) represents a wire connecting two lamps and 1 <= x_i, y_i <= n and x_i != y_i
postconditions.description: Each wire must connect two distinct lamps, each with an index between 1 and n, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: The scheme must be a valid garland structure
postconditions.description: The scheme must form a single connected path from the lamp connected to the grid to all other lamps.

postconditions.expression: The output must match the list a_1, a_2, ..., a_{n - 1}
postconditions.description: The indices of the main lamps for the wires must match the given list, in descending order of importance.

postconditions.expression: If it is impossible to restore the scheme, print -1
postconditions.description: If there is no valid scheme that matches the given list of main lamp indices, print -1.

invariants.expression: The lamp connected to the grid is the root of the tree formed by the wires
invariants.description: The lamp connected to the grid is the starting point of the scheme, and all other lamps are connected to it through the wires.

invariants.expression: Each wire connects two lamps, with one being the main lamp and the other being the auxiliary lamp
invariants.description: For each wire, the given main lamp index is the main lamp for that wire, and the other lamp is determined by the scheme.

invariants.expression: The scheme must form a single connected path
invariants.description: The scheme must be a single path from the root lamp to all other lamps, ensuring that cutting any one wire will not disconnect the grid lamp from the rest of the garland.
